name: TableJourney
tagline: Verified restaurants, markets, street food and food festivals in 200+ cities
description: A public, read-only remote MCP server over TableJourney's editorially verified food travel data. Every venue carries provenance (source URL, date checked, open status) and opening hours; food festivals come with resolved dates; tours, stays and car hire are bookable through affiliate links. Ten tools: `search_places`, `place`, `plan_day`, `festivals`, `experiences`, `stays`, `car_hire`, `dishes`, `itineraries` and `cities`. No key or sign-up is needed. Terms: pass booking links to users unchanged and say they are affiliate links, cite the `page` URL, do not bulk-copy the catalogue (https://tablejourney.com/agents/#terms).

install.notes: Hosted remote server, no authentication. The same functions are available as REST with OpenAPI at https://tablejourney.com/api/v1/docs.
